itemList.description:
Providing and applying tack coat with RSI Bituminous Emulsion using
emulsion pressure distributor at the rate of 0.20 kg/m2 on the
prepared bituminous surface cleaned with mechanical broom

Providing and laving Bituminous Concrete with not less than 40/60TpH capacity HMP using crushed aggregates of specified grading, premixed with bituminous binder VG-30 @ 4.78% Bitumen and waste plastic 8% of Bitumen of mix and fller, transporting the hot mix to work site, laying with mechanical paver finisher to the required grade, level and alignment, rolling with smooth wheeled, vibratory and
tandem rollers to achieve the desired compaction as per MORTH
specification clause No. 507 complete in all respects

Providing and laying of hot applied thermoplastic compound 2.5 mm thick including relectorising glass beads @ 250 g/m2 area, thicknes IRC:35:2015.The finished surface to be level, uniform and free from streaks and holes

Supplying and Fixing of Molded Shank Raised Pavement Markers /
Cat's eye made of polycarbonate and ABS moulded body and rellective panels with micro prismatic lens capable of providing total internal relection of the light entering the lens face and shall support a load of to Specisications of Category A of MORTH Circular No W/NH/33023/10-97 DO II Dt 11.06. 1997, The height, width and length shall not exceed 50 mm, 100 mm and 102 +/-2 mm and with minimum retective area of 13 cm2 on each side and the slope to the base shall be 35 +/-5 degree, The strength of detachment of the
integrated cylindrical shanks, (of diameter not less than 19 +/-2mm
and height not Jess than 30+/-2 mm) from the body is to be a minimum value of 500 Kg. Fixing will be by drilling
